duration.description: From the start of the first span to the end of the last, as a Go duration.

failed_spans.description: The number of spans that failed.

nats_calls.description: The number of NATS calls left out, the bookkeeping of the job queue. all shows them.

nats_time.description: The time that the NATS calls left out took, as a Go duration.

services.description: The services that made the spans, in the order each first appears.

spans.description: The spans that have no parent in the trace, each with its children, in start order.

children.description: The spans under this one, in start order.

detail.description: What the span acted on, as key=value pairs, led by error= on a failed span.

duration.description: How long the span took, as a Go duration.

name.description: The name of the span, such as job.process.

on.description: What ran the span: the role of its service, such as controller, agent or cli.

attributes.description: The attributes of the span, each as text.

duration_ms.description: How long the span took, in milliseconds.

kind.description: The span kind, such as server, client, producer or consumer.

name.description: The name of the span, such as job.process.

parent_span_id.description: The ID of the parent span. Empty for the root.

service.description: The service that made the span, such as osapi-agent.

status.description: Whether the work of the span failed.

status_message.description: The error of a failed span.

status.description: The job's status on a job.process, changed or unchanged on a behavior write, and ok or error on other spans.

error.description: A description of the error that occurred.

reason.description: Why the request failed, as a word that a program can branch on. The HTTP status is the class of the problem; the reason is the cause, and the error is the message for a person, which can change between releases. invalid_request: the request breaks a rule, such as a missing field (400). unauthorized: no token, or a token that is not valid (401). forbidden: the token does not have the permission (403). not_found: the host or osapi does not have what the request names (404). not_managed: the item is there, but osapi did not deploy it, so osapi does not change it (409). not_installed: the host does not have a program that the request needs (409). conflict: the state of the item blocks the request, such as a create of one that exists (409). unavailable: a part that osapi depends on is down, such as NATS (503). server_error: the controller failed; its log has the cause (500).
